name: Filters VPC DNS
description: A Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall rule group filters the DNS queries of a VPC (rule group -> VPC): one edge per FirewallRuleGroupAssociation. The association's priority orders rule groups within the VPC, and mutation protection blocks changes to it; both are properties from AssociateFirewallRuleGroup.

priority.description: The association's Priority: lower evaluates first among rule groups on the VPC (AssociateFirewallRuleGroup).
